newsitem.title: ITALY: San Paolo bank stock surges in Milan.
newsitem.headline: San Paolo bank stock surges in Milan.

text.p: Shares in San Paolo bank rose strongly to new year's highs on the Milan bourse, boosted by press talk about plans of the new management at Italy's biggest bank following its May public share placement, dealers said.
At 0930 GMT, San Paolo was 5.46 percent up at 13,990 lire after an earlier high at 14,100 lire.
Business daily Il Sole 24 Ore on Tuesday said new San Paolo managing director Luigi Maranzana aimed to reshape the bank's structure with the aim of increasing profits in all sectors.

"We were already positive about the bank but certainly such a plan points to a new direction looking to give added value to the company and shareholders which has got to be a good thing," one dealer said.
"The share price has zoomed through our targets which had been around 12,000 to 12,500 lire," he added.
The Milan bourse was again firmer on Tuesday continuing its recent rally.
